headword: {一味唐辛子|いちみとうがらし}

definitions.gloss: ground red chili pepper; cayenne pepper
definitions.explanation: A single-ingredient spice made from dried and ground red chili peppers. A standard condiment on Japanese dining tables, used to add heat to noodles, grilled dishes, and more.

examples.japanese: ⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一味唐辛子|いちみとうがらし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: To sprinkle ground chili pepper on udon.

examples.japanese: {一味唐辛子|いちみとうがらし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{引|し}き{締|し}まる。
examples.english: Adding a little ground chili pepper tightens up the flavor.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一味唐辛子|いちみとうがらし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{七味唐辛子|しちみとうがらし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いてある→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: At this restaurant, both ground chili pepper and seven-spice blend are available on the table.

notes: Literally 'one-flavor chili pepper,' meaning it contains only chili pepper with no other spices mixed in. Contrast with {七味唐辛子|しちみとうがらし} (seven-spice chili blend), which combines chili with ingredients like ⟦{山椒|さんしょう}→山椒：12412_sanshou⟧ (Japanese pepper), {陳皮|ちんぴ} (dried citrus peel), and sesame. Often shortened to ⟦{一味|いちみ}→一味：11238_ichimi⟧ in casual speech. A staple condiment at ⟦{蕎麦|そば}→蕎麦：14329_soba⟧ and udon restaurants.
